verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Dataform can 'schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery', with dependency-tree visualization and Git-based pipelines. BigQuery also lets you schedule load jobs and batch data transfers 'at regular intervals', which covers the core of recurring jobs and workflows. missing for 10: native scheduled-query details (cron syntax, triggers, monitoring and retries), any evidence of scheduling driven programmatically or by an agent for the AI-native persona, and independent or hands-on corroboration; scheduling also leans on the adjacent Dataform service.
